summary: Ansible 11 removes inspur.sm (still installable), the t_systems_mms.icinga_director collection (use telekom_mms.icinga_director), and the deprecated frr.frr, ngine_io.exoscale and openvswitch.openvswitch collections.
questions: What do I use instead of t_systems_mms.icinga_director?

answer_card.title: icinga_director rename and other removals
answer_card.answer_md:
- `t_systems_mms.icinga_director` is gone. Update FQCNs to `telekom_mms.icinga_director`.
- `inspur.sm` is removed but still installable with `ansible-galaxy collection install inspur.sm`.
- `frr.frr`, `ngine_io.exoscale` and `openvswitch.openvswitch` are removed.
